petersen2012_yeast_stall@1.locator: Figure 1 (yeast traces), Figure 2 (uncoupled hydrolysis correction), Figure 4 and supplementary Tables S2 and S4
petersen2012_yeast_stall@1.preparation: Purified Saccharomyces cerevisiae mitochondrial ATP synthase in proteoliposomes. The external assay medium faces the catalytic domain.
petersen2012_yeast_stall@1.Q_definition: Numerical value of [ATP]/([ADP][Pi]) with concentrations in M. The paper reports concentrations in the assay medium.
petersen2012_yeast_stall@1.limits: Initial rates are slopes fitted to ATP traces. Equilibrium gradients are interpolated. The comparison of relative shifts assumes a constant conversion from the reported nucleotide and phosphate quotient to the free activity quotient. Heat was not measured.
